chalisa.do1: O Pitareśvara, lord of the ancestors, give your blessing. I have bowed my head at your feet: place your hand on my head.
chalisa.do2: First of all we worship Gaṇeśa, then the god of the house. O Pitareśvara, be merciful and fulfil the wish of the heart.
chalisa.cau1: O Pitareśvara, light up the path; the dust of your feet is an ocean of liberation. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Pitareśvara has done the greatest kindness: he has granted birth as a human being. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: Whoever holds mother and father dear in his heart as gods gains the boundless fruit of life. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: Victory, victory, victory to you, revered ancestors, lord. Without paying the debt to the ancestors there is no liberation. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Your glory is on every side; in trouble yours alone is the support. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Nārāyaṇa is the support of creation; the ancestors are a part of that same vision. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: The Lord's command is proclaimed, that you be worshipped first; you yourself have the door of fortune opened. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: At Jhunjhunū your court is adorned; there you are enthroned with all the gods. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: When pleased, you have granted the fruit the heart desires; when angered, you have taken away the understanding. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: The glory of the ancestors is unlike any other; men and women sing its virtues. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: You are enthroned in the three realms, and shine as the Vasus, the Rudras and the Ādityas. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: Lord, all wealth is yours; I am your servant, with my son and my wife. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: The fifty-six dishes do not please you; you are satisfied with pure water alone. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Worship of you brings the highest good; great and small, all are entitled to it. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: You are worshipped as the sun rises; five handfuls of water please you. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: Flags and banners adorn the shrine; you are present in the undying flame. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Your flame is centuries old; our birthplace has been blessed. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: Our martyrs are worshipped here; they proclaim the message of devotion to the motherland. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: The ancestors of all the world: that is our principle; it is not the slogan of a religion or a caste. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Hindu, Muslim, Sikh and Christian, all worship the ancestors, brother. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Our family tree is Hindu; it is dearer to us than life. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: This is the Gaṅgā of the desert land, of a place where the water offering to the ancestors is a duty. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Brother, do not leave their feet; by their grace alone the Lord's refuge is gained. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: On the fourteenth day we hold a night vigil; on the new moon we bow down before them. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: All keep the jāt (the vowed pilgrimage to the family shrine) and the jaḍūlā (a child's first tonsure); all have the Nāndīmukha śrāddha performed. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Blessed is that flower of the birthplace which has received the dust of the ancestors' domain. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Śrī Pitarjī, benefactor of devotees, Lord, hear our plea. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Whoever meditates on you night and day, there is no other devotee like him. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: You are the lord and helper of those who have no one; you are always the helper of the humble. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: All four Vedas bear witness to the Lord; you have kept the honour of your devotees. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Whoever takes your name, no one else is as blessed as he. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: Whoever massages your feet every day, all nine siddhis roll at his feet. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Your power is wholly a blessing to one who gives himself up to you. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Whoever sets his mind on your feet surely gains liberation. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Whoever sings your praise with a true heart surely gains the four fruits of life. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: You alone are our god and our family deity; you alone are the guru, dearer than life. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Whoever has a true hope in his heart, he gains the fruit he desires. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Not even Śeṣa with his thousand mouths can sing your glory and the greatness of your wisdom. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: I am utterly humble, impure and sorrowful; how shall I make my prayer to you? ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Now, Pitarjī, have mercy on this humble one, and grant me some devotion to you and some of your strength. ॥40॥
chalisa.do3: Give the ancestors a place at a holy site and in your own village; let flowers of faith be offered there, and every work is fulfilled.
chalisa.do4: Our great ancestors are enthroned at the abode of Jhunjhunū; the sight of them makes life fruitful; the whole world worships them.
chalisa.do5: Whoever wants a fruitful life should go to the abode of Jhunjhunū; take the dust of the ancestors' feet, and life becomes fruitful and great.
